g.text: 1 m = 8 px • X → −Z ↑ • source geometry • Y = world height (metres) • killY -32 m
Actual game scenery + editable outlines. Transparent enemy and crate cutouts are centred on their exact X / Z positions.
CP checkpoint ◆ crystal ○ bonus entrance Blue = rails Purple = motion Surface labels = maximum Y
Draw above the map. Keep its title and A–D reference crosses for precise annotation return.
